newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm briefly, dip on Eurobond news.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm briefly, dip on Eurobond news.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds firmed after Russia launched a $2 billion Eurobond but dealers said on Thursday the rise was brief as the market was watching other emerging markets.
Russia on Thursday raised $2.0 billion, twice the amount originally expected, in the international capital markets with the launch of a 10-year Eurobond.
Dealers said MinFin prices firmed briefly 0.25-0.40 point after the Eurobond news.

"It is difficult to say whether it was a reaction to Eurobond or firmer U.S. Treasuries. There was buying after the news but people started to sell pretty soon and prices came back to earlier levels," an Aljba Alliance dealer said.
"It could have been a longer upward trend if the move had been supported by a rise in other emerging markets and Treasuries," he added.
